text:
maria_support: @beta-sre we're seeing 429s from dedicated pool 'eu-central-reserved-14' starting ~07:12UTC. Can you share tenant id + example request ids?

beta-sre: Tenant=beta-inc, req_ids=`r-8f7b2a9c` Happening across chat/generate endpoints. Latency normal, then immediate 429s.

sam_oncall: Looks like per-tenant 429s, not pool-wide? Any autoscale events?

ops_alertbot: AUTOSCALE: pool eu-central-reserved-14 scaled down by 2 nodes at 07:09UTC (trigger: low CPU).

lee_runtime: Can you paste the edge gateway logs for one req id? also echo rate-key header (x-rw-rate-key).

beta-sre: log snippet: `2026-03-15T07:12:33Z INFO req r-8f7b2a9c status=429 reason=quota_exceeded rate_unit=minute allowed=60 used=61`

maria_support: Huh 'rate_unit=minute' — our config importer should convert to per-second. Did you just migrate plan?

beta-sre: We rolled plan last night via billing API; noted a small plan name change.

sam_oncall: Querying tenant rate config... `SELECT rate_value, rate_unit, burst FROM tenant_rate WHERE tenant_id='beta-inc';` -> returns `60 | minutes | 0`

lee_runtime: `burst=0` is suspicious. Recent config importer patch (2026-03-12) had a YAML edge-case: missing `burst` parsed as null then serialized incorrectly -> `0`. Repro locally: `yaml.safe_load("burst:") -> None` then serializer `int(None)` -> 0.

maria_support: If burst=0 then token-bucket can't absorb short spikes. We'll temp override. @sam_oncall can you push tenant override to `burst=600`?

sam_oncall: doing now: `curl -XPOST https://internal-api/tenant/beta-inc/override -d '{"burst":600}'` -> 200 OK

ops_alertbot: CONFIG_UPDATE: tenant beta-inc override applied by sam_oncall at 07:18UTC

beta-sre: Confirmed - 429s dropped after ~2 min. Thanks.

lee_runtime: Root cause summary: billing migration wrote `rate_unit='minutes'` and the config importer patch mishandled missing `burst` defaulting it to 0. Impact: short spikes were rejected even though hourly/minute quotas were fine.

maria_support: Created INF-4292 with reproducer and assigned to eng-runtime. Follow-ups: patch importer to treat missing `burst` as NULL -> use default 300; add unit-conversion tests for minute/second/hour; customer-facing note for plan migrations.

sam_oncall: I'll roll revert for the importer patch and schedule hotfix. Linking CI run + logs: https://internal/ci/1234

lee_runtime: Also adding alert rule to detect tenant burst=0 in prod configs so we catch this earlier.
